verdicts.reason: A re-flows the design for the tall format: the headline is moved above the product and enlarged, and the CTA is enlarged. Its flaws: the sticker is shrunk to a tiny tile jammed beside the legal line at the bottom, the legal text is left-aligned and too small to read, and there is a large dead gap between the can and the CTA. B is just a shrunk copy of the square layout: the can, headline and CTA are all undersized and float in large empty bands, the sticker sits on its own near the top-right edge, and the legal text is too small to read.
